TASK 2 (Parent Home Upcoming Fees) HAS A REAL BUG — see frontend_issues.integration_issues[0].

integration_issues.issue: ParentHome.jsx declares `const [sched, setSched] = useState(null)` and computes `upcomingFees` from `sched?.schedule`, but NO fetch of /api/fees/student/{activeChildId}/fee-schedule ever happens. `setSched` is never called anywhere in the file. Result: after creating a live LKG assignment for Gaurav Gurjar (assignment id efbb5a8d-…, schedule endpoint confirmed to return 10 active months: April=partial, May/July=overdue, Aug/Sept=pending, monthly ₹2,115, annual ₹21,150), parent login 6376066570/066570 → /parent shows Balance Due ₹19,400.00 correctly BUT Upcoming Fees card renders 'No upcoming fees — you're all clear.' with 0 [data-testid^='parent-upcoming-month-'] rows. Same-page /parent/pay uses a different fetch and shows the schedule correctly — confirming this is a missing-fetch bug on Home only.

action_items: HIGH — Fix ParentHome.jsx to fetch the fee schedule. Add to the existing useEffect (around line 29) a 5th Promise: `api.get('/fees/student/${activeChildId}/fee-schedule').catch(() => ({ data: null }))`, then `setSched(schedResp.data)`. Without this, the Upcoming Fees card is always empty even when assignments/schedule exist — which is exactly the scenario Task 2 is meant to solve for the post-wipe re-assignment flow. The endpoint already works (verified via API + used correctly in ParentPay & StudentDetail).

OPTIONAL — the upcoming-month row testid uses `m.month` (string like 'April 2026'?) but the schedule payload also carries `m.index` (used elsewhere). Consider standardising on `m.index` for testid stability.
critical_code_review_comments: ParentHome.jsx line 19 vs line 47 — dangling `sched` state with no fetcher. This should have been caught before shipping; recommend adding a simple lint rule / unit smoke that Upcoming Fees renders non-empty when schedule has ≥1 pending month.

FeeCollection.jsx picker cap is now .slice(0,500) which comfortably clears the 375-student KNP branch; if a school ever exceeds 500 students the same class of bug will silently return. Consider using classFilter='all' + a warning banner 'Showing first 500 of N — pick a class filter to narrow' when pickerStudents.length > 500.

StudentDetail.jsx still imports `Pencil` (used only by the Edit Details button on the header now) and keeps `editingAssignment` state + `openAssign(assignment)` signature even though the edit path is gone — harmless but dead-code.

rca of the issue: ParentHome.jsx uses `sched` in JSX (lines 47-49) but never calls setSched anywhere; the useEffect on line 24 fetches dues/attendance/homework/circulars only. Result: upcomingFees = (null?.schedule || []).filter(...) = []; the card always shows the empty state. Mitigation: add `api.get('/fees/student/${activeChildId}/fee-schedule').catch(()=>({data:null}))` to the Promise.all and `setSched(s.data)` on resolve.
